title: Save every setting
ticket: After pressing Save, the page says 'Saved 0 settings'. When I reload, my changes are usually there, but not always.
hints: The function reports success before the saves have finished. Look at how it loops over the settings and what it actually waits for.
`forEach` ignores whatever its callback returns. An `async` callback returns a promise, but nothing awaits it, so `saveAll` returns the still-empty `saved` array while the requests are in flight.

Use a loop that can await: `for (const setting of settings) { ... }` with the `await fetch(...)` inside. (If the saves can run at the same time, `await Promise.all(settings.map(async (setting) => ...))` also works.)
theory: `Array.prototype.forEach` calls its callback and throws away the return value. With an `async` callback, that return value is a promise, so the loop starts every request and moves on without waiting, and the enclosing function finishes early. The symptom is misleading: the work usually does happen, just later, so it looks like a flaky server. Use `for...of` with `await` to run steps one after another, or `map` plus `Promise.all` to run them in parallel and wait for all of them. Errors thrown inside a forEach async callback are also lost, because nobody is listening for them.
